name: Bears
overview: The Bible uses the imagery of bears to convey strength, danger, and divine judgment. Proverbs warns of the fierce protection a bear shows when robbed of her young, illustrating the peril of confronting folly. Hosea depicts God’s judgment as a bear bereaved of her whelps, emphasizing the severity and relentlessness of His wrath. Additionally, Revelation describes a beast with feet like a bear, symbolizing powerful authority and destructive force. These references collectively reveal bears as symbols of formidable power and divine retribution in Scripture.
